title: Add synchronized_hop_channel to protocol.py matching spec SelectChannel pseudocode + independent hash_32 oracle
description: Implement deterministic hop_channel(sfn: int, eui64: bytes, num_channels: int=8, epoch: int=0) -> int using FNV hash_32(CONCAT(EUI BE, epoch LE u32)) % N +1 per 02a-coordinated-capacity.md:120-125 and ccp16-hop.json. Use _hash_32 from generate.py as oracle (never code-under-test). Update docstring with file:line ref. No dead code.
close_reason: hop_channel(sfn, eui64, num_channels=8, epoch=0) in python/src/lichen/sim/protocol.py matches spec SelectChannel (spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:190-196, spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md:81-86); docstring cites file:line; added 8-byte EUI validation. Independent literals in python/tests/sim/test_protocol_hop_channel.py derived via test/vectors/generate.py _oracle_hash_32; spec_example_eui_sfn1 matches spec appendix 3.2 worked example (0x373854FC -> channel 5); ccp15_freq_agility_epoch42 from committed ccp15.json. 13/13 pass; parity with rust select_channel proven over 480-row spread incl sfn=0/0xFFFFFFFF and eui 00*/ff*.
